text: 香港金管局、香港证监会、香港保监局、香港积金局联合香港数码港公布第一期生成式人工智能（GenA.I.）沙盒++参与者名单，包括蚂蚁银行（香港）、中国银行（香港）、华夏银行（香港）等30家金融机构，蚂蚁数字科技、同花顺国际、腾讯云等27家科技公司。
text_en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission, Hong Kong Insurance Authority, and Hong Kong Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority, together with Hong Kong Cyberport, announced the first batch of participants in the Phase 1 Generative AI (GenA.I.) Sandbox++, including 30 financial institutions such as Ant Bank (Hong Kong), Bank of China (Hong Kong), and Hua Xia Bank (Hong Kong), and 27 tech companies such as Ant Digital Technologies, Hithink International, and Tencent Cloud.
